WITH actor_film_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    actor_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
film_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS total_distinct_films
  FROM film_actor
),
actor_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(film_count) AS avg_film_count
  FROM actor_film_counts
)
SELECT 
  afc.actor_id,
  afc.film_count,
  afc.film_count / fs.total_distinct_films AS proportion,
  afc.film_count / fs.total_distinct_films - aa.avg_film_count / fs.total_distinct_films AS difference_from_avg
FROM actor_film_counts afc
CROSS JOIN film_stats fs
CROSS JOIN actor_avg aa
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
